description.value: A spellstriker staff is wrought iron with gleaming arcane sigils etched into its surface and a sharp point at the bottom. Used as a weapon, the staff is a staff. An explosion of magical energy—stored up for the SoM—explodes out. All creatures in a 5-foot emanation take 1d6 damage per level of the spell, with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC. This damage is the same type the spell would have dealt, and the activation gains that trait; if the spell would have dealt multiple types of damage, choose one of them. If the damage of the explosion is mental, the save is Will instead of Reflex. You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list. Used as a weapon, the staff is a staff. blink charge, echoing weapon, vampiric touch acid arrow, weapon storm blink charge, true target
